arguments.Code:
using UnityEngine;using System.IO;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand {public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){File.WriteAllText("artifacts/high_speed_drive/garage-ego-"+c.VehicleId+".json",c.LatestObservationJson);result.Log(c.VehicleId+" "+c.Status+" "+c.DiagnosticReason);} }}
